name: 32433 · Defuniak Spgs, FL
findings: ZIP 32433 (Defuniak Spgs) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32433 (Defuniak Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32433 (Defuniak Spgs) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).
